$comment: How BC Transit's routes are drawn where the GTFS alone doesn't say; every route in the feed is drawn by default, and the format is in config/feeds/translink/routes.json. Each system is an agency of its own (feed.json → static.parts), so entries match it by `agency`, and keys are qualified by it in the plan ("95@victoria"). No 'color': most systems give every route its own in the GTFS; the Sunshine Coast and qathet give every route 000000, which the plan treats as no colour (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#routes), and West Coast's one route has it too, so it is drawn in the same grey (#666666, the colour of routes without one; exports of 2026-10-28). The 95 is Victoria's Blink RapidBus and the 1 the Nanaimo Rapid Line, each drawn in its own colour as BC Transit brands them (https://www.bctransit.com/victoria/, https://www.bctransit.com/nanaimo/schedules-and-maps/, checked 2026-10-28).
